items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Did you put those in there yourself, Ollie? I did.

ctx.x: Oh, that's what I wonder about your snare drum, how you keep it up the pitch.

Oh, that's a red there, so there's a red reflector in there, or is it a red bulb? Yeah, you see? Oh, yeah. Oh, what happens, what happens there? Another bulb comes on, huh? And a blue one? They're a different colored bulb. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, they keep flashing on and off. Grim is in the color. Did you put those in there yourself, Ollie? I did.
There. Uh-huh. And that keeps the head tight. Tight.
